test_canonicalize_text: test the utils.canonicalize_text function to normalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, and appending a period
test_traverse_with_names: test the utils.traverse_with_names function to traverse JAX pytrees and yield (leaf_name, leaf_val) pairs
test_tree_flatten_with_names: test the utils.tree_flatten_with_names function to flatten a JAX pytree with leaf names

test_load_checkpoint: test the utils.load_checkpoint function to load a JAX checkpoint from a .npz file
